cards.audioText: N: [Your callsign is BAW390, a flight from Wuhan to London, Bay 208, you have ATIS Z, request Delivery for your ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你的呼号是英航309，一架从武汉飞往伦敦的航班，你现在在208机位，收到通播Z，向放行申请管制许可。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, BAW390, from Wuhan to London, Bay 208, ATIS Zulu, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，英航390，从武汉飞往伦敦，208机位，通播Z，申请管制许可。

cards.audioText: C: BAW390, cleared to London, runway 18R, ZF-13D departure, flight planned route, initial climb to and maintain 1800m, cruising level 9500m, expect level change en route, squawk 5505.
cards.audioTextZh: C：英航390，可以飞往伦敦，跑道18右，ZF13D离场，计划航路，初始高度1800米，巡航高度9500米，预计入行后变高度，应答机5505。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to London, runway 18R, ZF-13D departure, flight planned route, initial climb to and maintain 1800m, cruising level 9500m, expect level change en route, squawk 5505, BAW390.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以飞往伦敦，跑道18右，ZF13D离场，计划航路，初始高度1800米，巡航高度9500米，预计入行后变高度，应答机5505，英航390。

cards.audioText: N: [You are fully ready at Bay 208, request Wuhan Ground for pushback and startup.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你现在在208机位上完全准备好了，联系武汉地面请求推出开车。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW390, request pushback and startup.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，英航309，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: C: BAW390, after company Boeing777 enters adjacent Bay 207, pushback and startup approved, facing west.
cards.audioTextZh: C：英航390，公司的波音777进入到临近的207机位后，可以推出开车，头朝西。
cards.referenceText: After the traffic enter adjacent Bay 207, pushback and startup approved, facing west, BAW390.
cards.referenceTextZh: 公司的波音777进入到临近的207机位后，可以推出开车，头朝西，英航390。

cards.audioText: N: [During pushback, the tow bar was bent, notify Wuhan Ground, you will hold at present position while waiting for a new tow bar.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【在推出过程中，你的拖杆断了，告知武汉地面，你将原地等待，等待新的拖杆。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW390, tow bar bent during pushback, we will hold at present position for a new tow bar.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，英航390，推出过程中拖杆断了，我们将原地等待，等待新的拖杆。

cards.audioText: N: [You have completed the pushback and startup procedures, now you find there is a problem with your nose wheel, request to hold position to have the maintenance examine the nose wheel.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你已经完成了推出开车程序，现在你发现你的前轮出现了问题，请求原地等待，让机务人员进行检查前轮。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW390, nose wheel problem, request hold position to check the nose wheel.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，英航309，前轮问题，请求原地等待，让机务人员检查下前轮。

cards.audioText: N: [The engineers have repaired the nose wheel, request Wuhan Ground for taxi instructions.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【机务人员已经修好了前轮，向武汉地面请求滑行指令。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW390, nose wheel repaired, request taxi instructions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，英航309，前轮已经修好，请求滑行指令。

cards.audioText: C: BAW390, taxi to holding point of runway 18R via Z4, C, hold at holding point 7.
cards.audioTextZh: C：英航390，经由滑行道Z4，C滑行到跑道18右等待点，在等待点7等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point of runway 18R via Z4, C, hold at holding point 7, BAW390.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道Z4，C滑行到跑道18右等待点，在等待点7等待，英航390。

cards.audioText: C: BAW390, A330 is taxiing northbound on C, follow that aircraft to holding point runway 18R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：英航390，滑行道C上有一架向北滑行的空客A330，跟着那架航空器滑行到跑道18右外等待点。
cards.referenceText: Follow the traffic to holding point runway 18R, BAW390.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跟着航空器到跑道18右外等待点，英航309。

cards.audioText: N: [You are at the holding point of runway 18R, you are ready for takeoff, call Wuhan Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【你现在正在跑道18右的外等待点，你准备好起飞了，呼叫武汉塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW390, holding point of runway 18R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，英航390，在跑道18右外等待点，准备好起飞了。

cards.audioText:
C: BAW390, caution, previous aircraft reported wind shear shortly after takeoff, what is your intention?
N: [Ask controller about the wind shear information for other departure runways.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：英航390，注意，之前的航班在起飞不久时候报告遇到风切变，你的意图是什么？
N：【询问管制员，其他起飞跑道的风切变信息。】
cards.referenceText: Request wind shear information for other departure runways, BAW390.
cards.referenceTextZh: 询问其他起飞跑道的风切变信息，英航390。

cards.audioText:
C: BAW390, there is no reported windshear for other runways.
N: [Advise controller that you want to change your departure runway to 18L.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：英航390，其他跑道没有风切变报告。
N：【告知管制员，你想把起飞跑道更改到18左。】
cards.referenceText: Request change to runway 18L, BAW390.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求更改跑道至18左，英航390。

cards.audioText: C: BAW390, roger, enter runway 18R, vacate via W4, report vacating.
cards.audioTextZh: C：英航390，收到，上跑道18右，经由W4脱离，脱离时报。
cards.referenceText: Enter runway 18R, vacate via W4, wilco, BAW390.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上跑道18右，经由W4脱离，将照办，英航390。

cards.audioText: N: [Now you are cruising at 9500m, overhead OBLIK, make the initial contact with Zhengzhou Control, and say your squawk number 5505.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你现在在9500米巡航，飞越OBLIK，与郑州区调建立初始联系，告知你的应答机编码是5505。】
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, BAW390, cruising at 9500m, over OBLIK, Squawk 5505.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，英航390，在9500米巡航，过OBLIK，应答机5505。

cards.audioText: C: BAW390, Zhengzhou Control, radar contact, offset 3miles right of track.
cards.audioTextZh: C：英航390，郑州区调，雷达看见了，右偏置3海里。
cards.referenceText: Offset 3 miles to the right, BAW390.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右偏置3海里，英航390。

cards.audioText: N: [There is towering cumulus build up ahead, you want to climb to 10100m to overfly, make the request to Zhengzhou Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【前方积云堆积得很高，你打算上到 10100 米高度飞越过去，向郑州区调提出请求。】
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, BAW390, towering CB ahead, request climb to 10100m to overfly.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，英航390，前方积云很高，请求上10100米飞越。

cards.audioText: N: [You found that you can not overfly the weather, request turn right heading 030, so you can be clear of the weather.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你发现你无法飞越天气，请求右转航向030，这样你可以避开天气。】
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, BAW390, negative overfly weather, request turn right heading 030 to get clear of weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，英航390，不可以飞越天气，请求右转航向030来避开天气。

cards.audioText:
C: BAW390, Zhengzhou Control, negative due to restricted airspace. You can turn right heading to 015 or turn left as required, which would you prefer?
N: [You decided to deviate to the right as turning left would no longer be feasible. Advise Zhengzhou Control.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：英航390，郑州区调，由于限制区，不可以。你可以右转航向015或者左转，你倾向于哪一个？
N：【因为无法左转，你决定右偏置，告知郑州区调。】
cards.referenceText: Request deviate to the right, BAW390.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求右偏置，英航390。

cards.audioText: N: [You are suddenly caught up in severe turbulence, you can not maintain altitude, advise Zhengzhou Control. This is an urgency call.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你突然遇到了重颠簸，你无法保持高度，告知郑州区调，这是一个紧急通话。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Zhengzhou Control, BAW390, experiencing severe turbulence, unable to maintain altitude.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，郑州区调，英航390，遇到了强颠簸，无法保持高度。

cards.audioText:
C: BAW390, Zhengzhou Control, roger, what is your intentions?
N: [Tell Zhengzhou Control you will need a further right deviation to heading of 090.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：英航390，郑州区调，收到，你的意图是什么？
N：【告知郑州管制，你需要继续右偏置到航向090。】
cards.referenceText: Request further deviation to the right to heading 090, BAW390.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求继续右偏置到航向090，英航390。

cards.audioText: C: BAW390, heading of 090 approved, report when you are able to turn left.
cards.audioTextZh: C：英航390，可以航向090，准备好左转时报。
cards.referenceText: Heading 090 approved, wilco, BAW390.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以航向090，将照办，英航390。

cards.audioText: N: [Your purser reports that several passengers have been injured during turbulence, they are in serious need of medical attention, you decided to return to Wuhan airport. Tell Zhengzhou Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你的乘务长报告说有几名乘客在颠簸时受伤了，他们急需医疗看护，你决定返回武汉机场，告知郑州区调。】
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, BAW390, passenger injured during turbulence and need medical help, request return to Wuhan.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，英航390，乘客在颠簸时受伤了，他们急需医疗看护，请求返回武汉。

cards.audioText: C: BAW390, turn left proceed to OBLIK, descend to and maintain 2700m.
cards.audioTextZh: C：英航390，左转直飞OBLIK，下2700米保持。
cards.referenceText: Turn left proceed to OBLIK, descend to and maintain 2700m, BAW390.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞OBLIK，下2700米保持，英航390。

cards.audioText: N: [Your aircraft now is in the Wuhan Approach control area, the condition of injured passengers are getting worse, call Wuhan Approach to make a landing as soon as possible.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你的飞机现在在武汉进近管制区，受伤乘客情况恶化，联系武汉进近，请求尽快着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, BAW390, injured passenger is getting worse, request landing as soon as possible.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，英航390，受伤乘客情况恶化，请求尽快着陆。

cards.audioText: N: [Advise Wuhan Approach you will require medical assistance after landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【告知武汉进近，着陆后你需要医疗协助。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, BAW390, request medical assistance after landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，英航390，着陆后请求医疗协助。

cards.audioText:
C: BAW390, how many injured passenger on board will require ambulance?
N: [Notify Wuhan Approach that 3 passengers are in serious conditions and will require ambulance and two more passengers suffered minor cuts and will require some first aid treatment at the airport.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：英航390，机上多少受伤乘客需要救护车？
N：【告知武汉进近，有3名乘客受伤严重，需要救护车，另外还有2名乘客有轻微擦伤，需要在机场接受一些初步治疗。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, BAW390, 3 passengers are in serious conditions and will require ambulance and two more passengers suffered minor cuts and will require some first aid treatment at the airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，英航390，有3名乘客受伤严重，需要救护车，另外还有2名乘客有轻微擦伤，需要在机场接受一些初步治疗。

cards.audioText: C: BAW390, roger, descent to and maintain 1200m, turn left heading 190, to intercept the localizer for runway 22, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: C：英航390，收到，下1200米保持，左转航向190，切跑道22航向道，建立后报。
cards.referenceText: Descent to and maintain 1200m, turn left heading 190, to intercept the localizer for runway 22, wilco, BAW390.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下1200米保持，左转航向190，切跑道22航向道，将照办，英航390。

cards.audioText: C: BAW390, you are 17 track miles to touchdown, you are high on your approach, increase your rate of descent.
cards.audioTextZh: C：英航390，你现在距离接地点17海里，你进近高度偏高，增加下降率。
cards.referenceText: 17 track miles to touchdown, increase rate of descent, BAW390.
cards.referenceTextZh: 距离接地点17海里，增加下降率，英航390。
